title: Soil Temperature Planting Window
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plant:sensor sensor_type=soil_temp
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(soil_temp_c) as soil_temp_c by bed _time
| where soil_temp_c>=10 AND soil_temp_c<=18
| sort - _time
description: Uses Soil-temperature probes telemetry to monitor when beds sit inside a practical planting-temperature window in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for timing for outdoor starts without manually checking every bed, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Soil-temperature probes data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It blends when beds sit inside a practical planting-temperature window so you can spot timing for outdoor starts without manually checking every bed before it becomes annoying.
